comment: Hand-written capture settings for scripts/generate-reference-shots.py. Keys are '<source path>::<symbol>' (or just '<symbol>'). Everything here is optional; omit an entry to take the defaults (480x360 still). Add 'motion' to shoot a GIF instead — only for symbols whose meaning cannot be read from a single frame (ADR-0008: DocC cannot use WebP, so motion costs a GIF).
